title: A horror game inside a living flesh cave
author: Orlandogameschool
selftext:
I’m developing **The Hollow** using TypeScript, Vite, and Three.js.

The loop is simple: carry a candle, light five permanent stations, navigate the mirrors, and reach the Eye. There’s no combat—the atmosphere, darkness, sound, and unsettling encounters create the tension.

A midpoint encounter introduces the **Angel of Filth**, formed from insects. Helping him strengthens his body as roaches gather around him. Ignoring him changes the Eye’s closing message.

**Asset development:** The project combines supplied Meshy-generated models, character and hand assets, Blender processing, procedural effects, and AI-assisted development. Large source models become optimized browser GLBs, while editable Blender files remain separate.  
The current art includes flesh pillars, seated candle bearers, articulated player arms, crawling hands, ornate mirrors, and the finale Eye. Most prop textures are 512px; hero assets use 1024px maps. Wet materials, membrane textures, fog, flames, insects, and slime add detail.

**Engineering:** Player collision shares the cave’s actual shape, rather than assuming a round tunnel. Saves preserve the five-light progression. A debug editor lets me adjust objects, cameras, lights, and effects.

**Current status:** The latest recorded checks passed 46 regression tests, typecheck, and production build. The WebGL alpha package is approximately 26.3 MB zipped.

**This is still an alpha.** We need more complete playthroughs, better hand alignment, pacing feedback, loading optimization, ect
